title: FIN-Seq (Frozen Immunolabeled Nuclei Sequencing)
author: Ryoji Amamoto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zxbf7in
materials: Prepare all solutions and keep on ice with the Dounce homogenizer.

From the Recoverall RNA/DNA Isolation Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific AM1975), mix 100 uL of Digestion Buffer and 4 uL of protease for each sample. Adjust accordingly based on the volume of the leftover supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare Dounce homogenizer
steps.instruction: Fill the glass Dounce homogenizer with 1 mL cold homogenization buffer.

steps.title: Fix tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Mince tissue into small pieces and place them in 1 % PFA for 5 min on ice.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue into the homogenizer and homogenize with the tight pestle for 10–15 strokes on ice, avoiding foaming.

steps.title: Transfer homogenate to tube
steps.instruction: Move the homogenate into a 5 mL polypropylene tube (Thermo Fisher catalog 14‑959‑11A).

steps.title: Layer onto sucrose bed
steps.instruction: Carefully add 2 mL sucrose‑bed solution to the bottom of the tube so that the homogenate remains above the sucrose layer.

steps.title: Centrifuge low‑speed
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 500 × g for 12 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Fix nuclei with PFA
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, add 1 mL 4 % PFA solution, resuspend the pellet, and incubate 15 min at 4 °C with rocking.

steps.title: Block nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Blocking Buffer and incubate 15 min at 4 °C with rocking.

steps.title: Wash after blocking
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Blocking Buffer containing the primary antibody (use a concentration higher than typical IHC as recommended for each antibody) and incubate 30 min at 4 °C with rocking.

steps.title: Wash post‑primary
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (first block)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Blocking Buffer and incubate 5 min on ice.

steps.title: Wash after short block
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Blocking Buffer containing secondary antibody diluted 1:1000, then incubate 30 min at 4 °C with rocking.

steps.title: Post‑secondary block
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Blocking Buffer and incubate 5 min on ice.

steps.title: Final wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Blocking Buffer.

steps.title: Final spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Hoechst gating for 2N nuclei
steps.instruction: Using the Hoechst fluorescence histogram, gate to collect only 2 N nuclei and exclude 4 N nuclei.

steps.title: Fluorescence gating with controls
steps.instruction: Apply appropriate wavelength plots; include secondary‑only controls to identify the immunolabeled population.

steps.title: Filter and prepare for FACS
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension and proceed to fluorescence‑activated cell sorting (FACS).

steps.title: High‑speed spin before lysis
steps.instruction: Spin at 3 000 × g for 7 min at 4 °C, then remove as much supernatant as possible.

steps.title: Nuclei lysis at 50 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the pellet at 50 °C for 3 h with the tube lid sealed with parafilm (note: this deviates from the manufacturer’s protocol).

steps.title: Post‑lysis storage option
steps.instruction: After incubation, store samples at –80 °C indefinitely or continue with the kit’s downstream steps.

steps.title: RNA elution
steps.instruction: Elute RNA in approximately 17 µL UltraPure water.

steps.title: RNA storage
steps.instruction: Store the eluted RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: Sort nuclei into blocking buffer
steps.instruction: During FACS, sort isolated nuclei directly into Blocking Buffer and keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Optionally run a RNA pico chip on an Agilent BioAnalyzer (RIN not accurate for nuclear RNA) or use Qubit/BioAnalyzer to estimate concentration; if fewer than 10 000 nuclei are collected, concentration may be below detection limits.

steps.title: cDNA synthesis with SMART‑Seq v4
steps.instruction: Proceed with the SMART‑Seq v4 protocol for cDNA synthesis and amplification.

steps.title: Low‑RNA amplification guidance
steps.instruction: If RNA concentration is too low for Qubit or BioAnalyzer, perform >16 rounds of amplification; run a High‑Sensitivity DNA chip on the BioAnalyzer after SMART‑Seq v4 and after Nextera indexing to verify library quality.
